name: hdl-h1-cpt-v1
note: HDL track H1 (docs/HDL_DATA.md): draft corpus for continued pretraining on Verilog / SystemVerilog / VHDL, about 75% HDL source code and 25% English + maths replay. Only raw code fields are used: descriptions and reasoning traces written by a model are left for the instruct stage (H3) after their generator is checked against the teacher rules. Card licences and revisions were read on 2026-10-25; license_verified stays false until the card is read again from the pod. Run the HDL decontamination check against VerilogEval v2, RTLLM v2.1 and CVDP before training: public GitHub Verilog contains HDLBits-style solutions.
